pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large polygonal dark regions with relatively sharp edge gradients. Individual patches primarily exhibit 4-to-6-sided geometry with high spatial area occupancy relative to the inter-patch spacing.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological network of light pathways forming clear junction nodes. Pixel thickness of the corridors remains narrow and consistent across the visible flank and neck regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette visible along the dorsal neck line against the background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A distinct vertical linear textural disruption and indentation is visible on the upper shoulder/dorsal ridge area, cutting through the standard patch geometry.
